name: HttpFetch
description: Minimal web fetcher: read URL content or headers from the command line, pure Python stdlib.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Fetch a URL and print body text (HTML tags stripped)

args.name: --max-bytes
args.description: Read at most N bytes, default 200000

commands.name: headers
commands.description: Fetch a URL (HEAD) and print response headers

commands.name: read
commands.description: Read adapter knowledge content (resource access contract)

provides.description: Fetch and inspect web pages from the command line.
